Container.Name: Multi-Coin Paper Daytrader
Container.Overview: I built this paper-only multi-coin day-trading simulator with a shared risk budget, deterministic demo data, and optional read-only Bitpanda Fusion market data. I expose no login, so I use the dashboard only inside a trusted LAN.
Container.Requires: I create /mnt/user/appdata/paper-trading-bot/data before startup and assign it to nobody:users (99:100). I follow docs/UNRAID.md for the complete installation.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: I expose my local dashboard on this port.

Config.Name: Persistent Data
Config.Description: I store SQLite data and cache here and make it writable by UID/GID 99:100.

Config.Name: Paper Only
Config.Description: I keep this true; the application refuses to start when it is false.

Config.Name: Data Source
Config.Description: I select either demo or fusion.

Config.Name: Fusion Read API Key
Config.Description: I optionally provide a key with Read permission only.

Config.Name: App Timezone
Config.Description: I use this timezone for daily limits and the session close.

Config.Name: Container Timezone
Config.Description: I use this timezone for the container and logs.

Config.Name: Pairs
Config.Description: I provide up to 10 comma-separated EUR pairs.

Config.Name: Starting Capital
Config.Description: I assign this virtual starting capital to each comparison strategy.

Config.Name: Risk Per Trade
Config.Description: I model this risk per trade and cap it at 0.01.

Config.Name: Aggregate Risk
Config.Description: I cap aggregate open risk at 0.02.

Config.Name: Daily Loss Limit
Config.Description: I cap the daily loss limit at 0.02.

Config.Name: Hard Drawdown
Config.Description: I use this persistent paper emergency-stop threshold.

Config.Name: Maximum Open Positions
Config.Description: I allow 1 to 3 positions across the portfolio.

Config.Name: Maximum Trades Per Day
Config.Description: I allow 1 to 6 new trades across the portfolio each day.

Config.Name: Fee Rate
Config.Description: I apply this simulated fee rate.

Config.Name: Slippage Rate
Config.Description: I apply this simulated slippage rate.

Config.Name: Candle Interval
Config.Description: I use this signal interval.

Config.Name: Trend Interval
Config.Description: I use this trend-filter interval.

Config.Name: Poll Seconds
Config.Description: I poll every 30 to 900 seconds.

Config.Name: Session Close Hour
Config.Description: I close paper positions at this local hour.

Config.Name: Session Close Minute
Config.Description: I close paper positions at this local minute.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: I keep persistent application data at this internal path.
